entries.text: Clayton, prayer for physical healing for disability, that God can continue to provide his base needs, and he can find people to support him, and give him community and support.

I wanna encourage every one of you to pray against the enemy, when we go out onto the field to evangelize, usually we experience spiritual attacks afterwards, could be anything negative, but pray against it, the enemy gets angry when he sees God winning, let’s stay strong in prayer, steadfast in our faith, obedient to His calling, and rest if you need to rest. No weapon formed against us shall prosper. In Jesus name!
Amen and Hallelujah 🙌🙏

Even last night I got so headachy and tired way earlier than usual, and this morning my head is hurting still, and maybe you’re feeling alone, maybe you’re feeling tired, confused, afraid, discouraged, but are those good things? No, because they’re from the enemy.

You are not alone, you will not be shaken, you will not fall, you will be upheld by Gods righteous right hand, He will provide for you all the people around who care for you, He will bless you abundantly, He will use times like this to shape you and discipline you like the loving Father He is. You are free, truly free indeed, “don’t let yourself be burdened by a yoke of slavery again”

I pray for strength, I pray for revival, I pray for peace and patience, I speak life into this day and every person, I pray for clarity, for guidance, discernment, wisdom. And I praise the name of the Lord most high, because He gives us beautiful friends, a wonderful ministry family who cares for you, for a roof over your head, for transportation, for food, He is so SO good!!! You will be okay, you are SO blessed!

In JESUS NAME!
Enemy is just mad we were working for the kingdom. Hold on tight brothers we shall be fine
Amen

Prayer for my boldness to return, my confidence.

It could be I am moving out of a time where God gave me boldness to share the Gospel with others.

Or it could be that I had the wrong foundation for the boldness (I do doubt this is the reason)

But that it may return, that I can walk in stride and obedience to where God calls me to be.

That I won't be afraid, that I can match forth, even though I am afraid, confused, overwhelmed.

Step by step.

That God will reveal to me what steps need to be taken so I may continue to march forth, and give me allotted times so I might see when I can get up and serve him.

I am still confused what God has asked me to do, or where to go.

I might just still be in a refinement period, however, I feel something big coming, and I want to be prepared.

I prayer for shelter for an upcoming metaphorical storm. Because I feel it.

I ask for wisdom and understanding.

But most importantly ears to "hear" (meaning the ability to do) What he's asking me to.

Help me not be double minded or anxious. To walk not to the left or right. Just forward with confidence.

Jesus is with me wherever I go

I think this is something we can talk about here. I would say the general Church in America as well as American culture says boldness is a sign of a great leader. However equally important, and in some context more important is meekness.

I would describe it as being gentle and patient where a situation calls for it - here you are controlling your strength instead of exerting it full force. 

For example, Jesus took the cross where it was in his power to call down the angels of heaven to completely "save" himself from the outcome.

And the storm is revealed.

So I need to get my physical therapy appointment set up along with my doctors note to make sure I don't lose my Job because they are going to put me back on morning stocking which will break my arms even more, and so due to not wanting to cause myself permanent damage I will likely have to quit if I don't get the appointment and the note to Costco by Nov 2.

So the prayers specifically is that I can keep my Job if its the lord's will.

I have a feeling I might lose my Job soon, so also I pray for comfort that everything is going to be alright.

I have faith he will not let me down, I will get the paperwork needed if its his will. Although once again, it might not occur. 

I trust his decision, his will he done

Thanksgiving Announcement 10/29/2026:

Hey, Seed the Word members! David Ageyev here again with you all and I just wanted to say a quick Thanksgiving announcement and a huge appreciation for all the prayers and the support I've been receiving either individually or as a whole from you all. 

It really means a lot and has been a huge motivator to help me keep going in my missionary work. As some of you may already have discovered I have been located in the country of Georgia, stationed in the city of Tbilisi (that is located near the Black Sea) 

I have personally witnessed and have been able to work with an amazing team that has crossed boundaries and we've seen how the Holy Spirit has been working amongst people of various ranks, social classes and backgrounds to achieve something truly amazing!

I am more than honored to say that God has not made any mistakes nor will He ever in sending out missionaries all around this world and I ask you all for continuous prayers as I am traveling the world fulfilling what I believe God has put in my heart as well as our ministry to do internationally.

Additionally, 

I want to say a huge thank you to every single individual for serving in other Ministries and being obedient to the call. God has put in their lives so that they could bring people onto Christ. 

I understand we all have individual roles to play, but you all have been such an inspiration to me, especially coming up in my own service to God and seeing how everyone has been used for His glory and continues to be used in this way.

Praying for each one of you (not just Seed the Word), may God continuously strengthen you and provide for you just as Isaiah 41 says,

Isaiah 41:10, 13-14 ESV 
[10] fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand. 
[13] For I, the Lord your God, hold your right hand; it is I who say to you, “Fear not, I am the one who helps you.” [14] Fear not, you worm Jacob, you men of Israel! I am the one who helps you, declares the Lord; your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

Prayer for Andrew, he was my Uber driver to my doctor's appointment, he is practicing heresy, he was saying how we are Gods (like literally having divine power in ourselves), God is a consciousness, and Jesus and the spirit are reflections of him, and we are like Jesus in that way. That his "church" encourperates Buddhism, Muslim beliefs, Hindusm, and other religions, and he rejected the Idea of even faith, but rather said that when we do things together... we can actually 

Prayer he may be placed on the right path.

Additionally follow up to my video, I actually wasn't able to get the light duty for my work, however was able to get stuff for my physical therapist appointment, I have an appointment scheduled tomorrow, so I can get everything I need however, rn, I got the paperwork so I can start healing
I got got me the appointment, and everything will work out.

(I realize this as I am taking the bus back from Everett) I actually would be late for work if I had actually had the appointment, and so God could have actually made it so my appointment gets canceled, and then gets moved to a better time for me to get the help I need and so I can make it to work today, and tomorrow 🙌)

As its stated in Romans, his reasons are unknowable and inscrutable

Prayer for my Uber driver, hes Muslim, I got to evangelize to him, he seemed very receptive, although I don't think he believes. I told him how and why Muslim beliefs diffentiate. I told him actually about how the Quran which says Jesus is a prophet and is true, also thereby proves Jesus is God because Jesus claimed to be God too. (I have watched lots of Muslim faith debunk videos 😉) he was quiet, but ultimately he didn't really say yes or no.

I ultimately told him, to promise not to put 666 anywhere on his body

Prayer Request 10/31/2026:

Please pray for evangelism outreach during this evil day of human sacrifice.

God is our strength and we will overcome by the power, authority, and name of Jesus Christ ✝️

Please pray for me and for my heart for any discouragement or tiredness or laziness, or even confusion or worry. pray for the people going out with evangelizing today for the trick or treaters, rebuke all witchcraft and evil spirits that may try to linger and attack us on this day.
Amen and Hallelujah to Jesus

Jesus, our mighty Lord.

Thank you for this new day. Today is a new day which means we can choose to make it better than yesterday, we can choose to let the enemy win over our minds, or to keep him out, we get to choose YOU, Lord. Isn’t that something? Thank you for giving us the freedom to choose, and not be trapped in darkness.

Lord thank you that we get to live another day, we never know when the day will come that You come back, but thank You for allowing us another day, another opportunity to love the people around us and to spread the good news, thank You for Your enduring love, thank you for Sunday being a day dedicated to you. Thank you for rest, thank you for the Word of God we get to read and know Your truths about who You are and who we are in You. Thank you for trials that shape us into better people, thank you for the cross. 

May we glorify you in everything we do and say, and think today, give us boldness and strength to keep going forward, guide our ways, and make Your will clear to us. 

I pray this in the mighty, matchless, most wonderful name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen
I love Jesus

Yay

Last night at Applebees we got to meet a homeless man, Jerry, and we got to pray for him and he said he had a Bible, but he just asks for sin to leave his life. He was a very sweet man. Keep him in your prayers ! 🙏🏻

Also guys plz be praying for my little brother Eric. He’s been acting strange and drawing weird demon faces and mocking me saying “you better pray for me or the demons will get me” and things. Being especially rude to me, disrespecting parents, etc.

Kindly requesting prayer, I've had a very minor physical altercation with a leader where I am staying and would appreciate it that God guides the situation for His glory.

They've attempted to remove my cell phone as a measure to prevent me from communicating online and instead of politely doing it, physical force was applied to the matter.

I've had a brief conversation with this individual and decided to postpone it to rest until I'm able to regain composure to speak on the matter again.

Prayer against abortion, I had a big debate with a family member, and so I pray they come to a changed mind at least on that. 

I pray that we also can go to the upcoming walk on Saturday.

I pray that we may protect the young. Let us not be like Sodom and Gomorrah (Romans 9:29)

Additionally I pray that my family will come to a knowledge and seek the Lord.

I pray that I may get to know where I need to go, and I may have courage to find it.

That I might not be afraid, and can make decisions that allow me to serve God boldly.

That I may not be conformed to this world, but tramsformed by the renewal of my mind. So I am no longer anxious or double minded.

That my faith will endure and produce fruit 30 fold 60 fold and 100 fold.

And that my ears to hear may lead to doing.

And my eyes may see the good and not evil. That inside there may not be great darkness.

Woe are we, for we are filthy.

Let us be cleansed in the son.

Amen
